help: Loads the provider catalog only when requested. Keep your current model or choose a returned model; saving and activation remain separate.
idle: Current model is preserved. Load the catalog to see available choices.
changed: Provider details changed. Load the catalog again; your model was not changed.
network: Could not load models. Your form has not changed. Try again.
invalid: Check the provider, HTTPS endpoint and credential fields.
conflict: This profile changed elsewhere. Reload it before loading models.
missing: The saved profile is no longer available. Reload Connections.
destination_changed: The destination changed. Enter its credential explicitly before loading models.
credential_unavailable: The saved credential could not be read. Re-enter it in the profile.
unreachable: The provider could not be reached safely. Check its public HTTPS endpoint.
provider_error: The provider rejected the models request. Check its API endpoint and availability.
provider_auth: The provider rejected the credential or model-list permission.
provider_rate: The provider is rate limiting requests. Try again later.
response_invalid: The provider returned an invalid or oversized model catalog.
empty: The provider returned no available models. Your current model is unchanged.
too_many: The catalog exceeds 1,000 models. Use a narrower provider endpoint or enter a model ID manually.
incomplete: The provider returned a paginated catalog. Enter the model ID manually; a partial list was not used.
